items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 120:1
items.html: When ZA is only in the aspect of the Mochin of the back, he has only the squares of the four kinds of HaVaYaH mentioned above in Answer 248, namely: the ten letters of the square of the simple HaVaYaH in his Keter; the 26 letters of the square of the ten letters of the HaVaYaH in the filling of Alephin in his Hochma; the 156 letters of the square of the 28 letters of the filling of the filling of the HaVaYaH of Alephin in his Bina; and the 26 letters of the square of the ten letters of the HaVaYaH in the filling of Alephin in his ZA.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 120:2
items.html: (To the question) And the Nukva of ZA is then the aspect of the Gematria of the four kinds of HaVaYaH in the square mentioned above, as above in Answer 248, which is called the Nukva within his body, namely his left side. And it is found that the Gematria of 72 of the back of the Malchut of the Keter is attached to the ten letters of the square of the simple HaVaYaH. And likewise the Gematria of the 26 letters of the square of the HaVaYaH of Alephin, which are the Malchut of Hochma, is attached to the 26 letters of the square themselves, which are the Sefira of Hochma. And likewise the Gematria of the 156 letters of the square of the filling of the filling, which is the back of the Malchut of Bina, is attached to the 156 letters themselves, which are the Sefira of Bina. And likewise the Gematria of the 26 letters of the square of the HaVaYaH in the filling of Alephin, which is the back of the Malchut of ZA, is attached to the 26 letters themselves, which are the back of the Sefira of ZA of ZA. And afterwards, at the time of the Nesira, these nine Malchuts mentioned above are sawn off from the nine Sefirot of ZA and given to the Nukva Rachel.
